# Vitreen

> Relationship intelligence for selling art & design. Vitreen puts a gallery's artwork records inside Gmail and WhatsApp, prepares replies to collectors from that inventory, and remembers who received what. A person on the gallery's team always reviews and sends; nothing is sent automatically.

Vitreen works alongside Artlogic, set up from Artlogic exports or from spreadsheets and folders. It costs €249 per month per gallery (or €199 per month paid yearly), with unlimited users and setup included; setup takes about a week.

## Product

- [Artwork inventory](https://vitreen.art/product/artwork-inventory): every work, its images, price and availability in one inventory, moved in from spreadsheets or exports.
- [Sales conversations](https://vitreen.art/product/sales-conversations): artwork records in Gmail and WhatsApp; replies to collectors prepared from the inventory and reviewed before sending; artwork PDFs on WhatsApp.
- [Collectors memory](https://vitreen.art/product/collectors-memory): what each collector asked, saw and received, in one history, with the next follow-up.

## Solutions

- [Art galleries](https://vitreen.art/solutions/art-galleries)
